[SWS_CM_00057] Mapping of Offer Service in case of Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF network binding
⌈
If instructed to offer a service instance which is mapped to a ProvidedUserDe-
finedServiceInstance of category SIGNALBASED_IEEE1722_ACF, then the
Signal-Based IEEE1722 ACF network binding shall create / use a socket for the
communication on the EthernetCommunicationConnector that the Provide-
dUserDefinedServiceInstance is mapped to via the UserDefinedServiceIn-
stanceToMachineMapping.communicationConnector. If a socket with identical
credentials already exists, then this existing socket shall be used.
⌋
